data.body: Final rebar-debug report. Problem: the real-history authorship fixture intermittently lost a freshly committed reachable blob before merge, producing invalid-object/write-tree failures. Proven root cause: its raw temporary Git repository omitted the ADR 0051 foreground-maintenance posture, so Git >=2.47 launched `git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach` after ordinary writes and could repack concurrently with later writes. Proof: the organic run 32130591202/job 95691543683 captured the missing blob plus two packs, MIDX, and zero-byte tmp_pack; Trace2 on the exact fixture captured repeated `--detach`, while both pins changed every child to `--no-detach`; repository-wide tracing rejected cross-test deletion, path aliasing, arbitrary process reaping, and explicit MIDX callers. Test: tests/unit/test_authorship_fixture_maintenance.py was frozen and observed behaviorally RED (`--detach`) before repair, held out from the blind fixer, GREEN afterward, and returned to the same RED under the exact two-line defect mutation before restoration. Fix: tests/unit/test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py now pins repo-local gc.autoDetach=false and maintenance.autoDetach=false before its first event. Scope and safety: fixture-local; caller sweep found no production dependency; it restores the accepted ADR 0051 invariant, adds no dependency/retry/error swallowing, preserves the complete topology/attribution module (13 focused tests passed), and weakens no existing test. Siblings: the construct sweep found the production tracker ensure and the two-clone bare-remote fixture already protected; no additional live unprotected sibling in this fixture path. Parity: CLI/MCP/library/automated production surfaces all converge through the protected tracker ensure; dual-direction reads do not trigger upkeep. Replication: hostile inherited detach defaults now yield only `--no-detach`; Change 1857 run 32133711577 passed every CI lane (duration 1710s), Gerrit received LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 with zero unresolved comments, and Change 1857 merged as 1af71dda575ca02c8a726a0ff63867ebf28f4189. Residual risk: none observed in scope; the earlier interrupted local-suite marker did not reproduce through 1,329 fail-fast passes, and the exact cached oracle node passed independently.
